The responses here are **synthetic**. They were written by hand to match the response shapes documented at https://openrouter.ai/docs/use-cases/usage-accounting (read Nov 24, 2026): `usage.prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens` and `cost` for Chat Completions, and `response.usage.input_tokens`, `output_tokens` and `cost` for Responses streams. They are not recorded traffic. No live calls and no keys are used in tests.
